# Coppalini Architecture — mathematics, physics, and source-indexed research

> Coppalini Architecture is an independent research and publication record for exact algebra, physics, proof sources, computational checks, and archival materials.

## Current public record

- [Formal Correspondence Ledger](https://eulershiddenl.ink/formal-correspondence/): named public forms beside Coppalini constructions, exact receipts, and stated scopes.
- [Home](https://eulershiddenl.ink/): formal lineage, Four Dual Forms, The 3 Body Mirror, Minimum Mechanics, the laboratory, and the library.
- [Metric Minimum / Symmetric Minimum v1.7.16](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/symmetric-minimum/): a source-addressable connection among three named constructions: the coframe field system \(\Pi\to(g,F_{\rm sol})\to F_{\rm em}\) and its stated regular Einstein–Maxwell reduction; the canonical Einstein–Maxwell state \((\gamma,\pi;A,E)\), whose normal bracket returns the metric shift and gauge adjustment under seven named premises; and the exact signed \(2×2\) fibre block \(G=[Q,\Omega]\). \(Q,J,H,L_{\rm ax}\) are independently checked operations on that block. The 28-word coordinate register is distinct from the \(\binom82=28\) pair reads of an eight-address carrier. The root-to-Hamiltonian/observable adapter remains open. The release includes source equations, 45 Lean modules, an independent 140/140 exact checker, 33 refusal controls, SHA-256 manifest, and repair ledger.
- [Minimum Mechanics 010a–010u](https://eulershiddenl.ink/proofs/minimum-mechanics/#ledger): 45 Lean source modules in one transitive import closure, with a public source ledger for theorem statements, source-documented models, physical interfaces, premises, and exact file links.
- [Proof verification](https://eulershiddenl.ink/verify): reproduction instructions and source-specific compiler, hash, and audit records for the locked version `b9e939d514a63fb021592f79a316f70cbc70ed8a`.
- [Machine-readable proof index](https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/minimum-mechanics-010u.json): all 21 stages and all 45 exact source paths.
- [Four Dual Forms](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library#four-dual-forms-shelf): Gravity–Light, Memory–Motion, Time–Scope, and Horizon–Silence, with individual source records and verification receipt.
- [The 3 Body Mirror](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/the-3-body-mirror.pdf): three-body reconstruction, source, symbolic receipt, and independent receipt.
- [Research Library](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library): current synthesis followed by all non-Language-Mechanics source records in one continuous library.
- [Language Mechanics](https://eulershiddenl.ink/language-mechanics): the field basis for reference, constraint, reader, receipt, and lawful reuse through change.
- [Laboratory](https://eulershiddenl.ink/architecture): gauge and matter viewers and source-aware computational programs.
- [Notice](https://eulershiddenl.ink/notice/): a standalone public technical statement of the reader-obstruction question and an independent technical-review route.
- [About](https://eulershiddenl.ink/about): author provenance and public research chronology.

## Current theorem strength

- 010a–010p: source-led finite and local suture, Maxwell, Palatini, ADM and canonical calculations; the six-bracket theorem in 010o is conditional on `SmoothCompletion` and names its smooth-field realization obligation.
- 010q–010r: source-led abstract two-sided non-entailment of a spectral gap from the named non-Abelian Gauss algebra.
- 010s–010t: local source attachment and a nonzero finite rational symplectic carrier; ordinary smooth real field completion is a distinct mathematical construction from full Lean formalization.
- 010u: a typed jurisdictional admission and pattern-recognition theorem over declared carriers; physical applications use separately named observables and conditions.
- `AxiomaticBuild.lean` is carried here by its summary and README as source-report records.

## Read a claim through its record
